note: Rulings from the KURIAKE C group on 9 Oct 2026 (Bishop Emmanuel Sakyi, Archbishop Eddie Fabin, Mother Nina) for pastors named on more than one bishop's submitted sheet. Applied after the sheets are read: the pastor stays under the ruled bishop and is removed from the other sheets' lists. 'rules' are general; 'people' are named individuals. Mother Nina's sheet (9 Oct) lists Eniola Ajiga, Joshua Korsi Gbafa and Joel Cobina Obuobisa as her pastors: they stay, with the pictures already on file (Joshua, 9 Oct: consolidate, keep the picture).
